headline-badge.title: Status badge (and actions) beside the h1 on desktop
headline-badge.why: A status badge beside the h1, and actions at the right of its row, are the design system PageHeader as intended (its Detail story); review-notes.md now says so.

org-root-blank.title: /o/$orgId shows an empty page
org-root-blank.fixIn: web/src/app/router.tsx: /o/$orgId redirects to its Workspaces page (done, not committed)
org-root-blank.why: In every variant the sweep found only the navigation's text there; the main area renders nothing.

phone-search-toolbar.title: Search placeholder cut off on phones
phone-search-toolbar.fixIn: @data-insights-ai/ui Toolbar: search and actions share one row on phones (propose first)
phone-search-toolbar.why: At 390 px the search shares its row with the ⋯ and action buttons, so its placeholder ends mid-word ('Search people an').

option-description-clamp.title: Option descriptions cut after two lines on phones
option-description-clamp.fixIn: @data-insights-ai/ui ChoiceGroup cards (.di-choice-card-desc clamps at 2 lines; propose first)
option-description-clamp.why: The option cards end their description with '…' and nothing shows the rest (seen: 'mediante su propio servidor de…'). The check measured the same overflow.

fact-grid-columns.title: Facts in 200 px columns on desktop
fact-grid-columns.why: Labels and values wrap in fixed 200 px columns while 450–900 px beside them stay empty; a subscription ID breaks over two lines at 1440 px.

phone-value-column.title: Values wrap in their column on phones
phone-value-column.why: Label/value rows on phones keep the value in its column and wrap it there: that is the layout (seen on the workspace status row).

word-breaks.title: Long words and hostnames break in narrow columns
word-breaks.why: Long German and Spanish words and hostnames hyphenate or break on phones; the hyphenation is correct.

untranslated-api-names.title: Report titles in English on German and Spanish pages
untranslated-api-names.why: The server writes a report title in the run language; the mock gave runs marked German the English title. Runs generated in English keep their English title, as on the server.

operator-404.title: Operator pages swept as a non-operator
operator-404.fixIn: .grok-bot/visual/sweep.spec.ts: operator pages under the installationAdmin scenario (done)
operator-404.why: The sweep opened /operator as an organization admin, who sees the notice to elevate first; the 404 is the server answer to a non-operator, as intended. The screenshots showed that notice, not the operator pages.

report-preview-mock.title: The report preview loads nothing in the mock
report-preview-mock.why: The run page's preview frame loads /downloads/reports/sample; the mock seems to answer with the app itself (its scripts blocked by the sandbox, sometimes a 404). Likely a mock gap, not the app: check in pnpm dev:mock.

wide-table.title: Wide tables: last column under the edge fade
wide-table.why: The assets table scrolls sideways with a fade at its edge, so at 1440 px the last column starts under the fade. Intended if wide tables scroll like tab bars; review-notes.md says so only for tab bars.

section-header-phone.title: Section description beside its button on phones
section-header-phone.why: On phones a section's description keeps a narrow column beside its Edit button and wraps to three lines, with the space under the button empty. A design-system layout choice; not looked at in detail.

glossary-misread.title: Grok: 'Findings', 'des Workspaces' break the glossary
glossary-misread.why: German keeps Finding and Workspace as nouns with normal plural and genitive (die Findings, des Workspaces); 'Casos' is the page's name.

terms-misread.title: Grok: technical terms must stay English
terms-misread.why: review-notes.md says the English terms ('Standing terms', 'Seed record') are intended; Grok reads that as 'do not translate them'. Clarifying that note stops these.

compound-hyphens.title: Grok: 'AI-SOC-Größe' breaks the glossary
compound-hyphens.why: German compounds with a multi-word name take hyphens (AI-SOC-Größe, Secret-Manager): correct spelling, not a glossary breach.

es-acronym-plural.title: Grok: 'CPU', 'AI SOC' need a plural s in Spanish
es-acronym-plural.why: Spanish leaves acronyms unchanged in the plural (las CPU, los AI SOC).

audit-style.title: Grok: the short audit/activity style is incomplete
audit-style.why: Audit and activity labels use a participle without subject throughout ('Workspace {{name}} angelegt'). Grok's versions break that; some are ungrammatical ('Hat einer Bestätigung … zugestimmt').

lowercase-fragments.title: Grok: fragments start lowercase
lowercase-fragments.why: The English source is lowercase too: these are fragments inside a line ('revoked {{at}}', 'reports not available yet').

term-inconsistent.title: One concept, several words
term-inconsistent.why: Seed record: 'Ausgangsdatensatz', 'Auslösender Datensatz', 'Startdatensatz'; seat: 'Kontositz' and 'Arbeitsplatz' (es 'asiento', 'puesto'); also Produktadministration/-administrator (7×/7×), Dienstzugang/Dienstkonto, Rücknahme/Zurückziehen, Standards/Vorgaben, es periodo/período (20×/18×) and portal de cuenta/cuentas. Grok's reasons are often wrong, the inconsistencies are real.

glossary-breach.title: Finding and Workspace translated against the glossary
glossary-breach.why: 'Funde', 'Befund' and 'Arbeitsbereich' where the glossary says Finding and Workspace.

reihenfolge.title: 'in Reihenfolge' is not idiomatic
reihenfolge.why: 'manipulationssicher und in Reihenfolge', 'nicht in Reihenfolge': German says 'in fester Reihenfolge' / 'nicht in der richtigen Reihenfolge'.

erklaeren.title: 'Quellen erklären' reads as 'explain sources'
erklaeren.why: For declaring sources absent, 'Fehlende Quellen erklären' reads as 'explain missing sources'. 'Quellen als fehlend erklären' says it.

gender-style.title: Paired or participle forms for people
gender-style.why: 'Von einer Analystin oder einem Analysten', 'als Lesende oder Verantwortliche': the glossary rules role names, these name people. Your style decision.

sample-source-name.title: A source named in English in the sample data
sample-source-name.why: A source is named by the person who adds it (the name starts empty); the seed names this one like its type. Sample data, like a case title.
